content.text: Spinal: herniated disc -> compress root (traversing/exiting root)
Periph: thick transverse carpal lig + tenosynovial swell -> compress median n. (carpal tunnel)
elbow flex + overlying retinaculum -> compress ulnar n. (cubital tunnel)
cervical rib/fibrous band/hypertrophied scalenes -> brachial plexus compress (thoracic outlet)
external P/leg-cross/prolonged squat -> common peroneal compress vs fibular head
Pain + paresthesias in n.'s sensory territory                                                                 **worse @night
advanced -> weak + atrophy in supplied musc                 -    affected root/n. reflexes diminished
compress/stretch n. = worse    -    wrist flex–carpal         -    elbow flex–cubital
-          Anatomic: congenital narrow tunnel, cervical rib, bony spurs, prior frx deformity
Occupational: repetitive joint motion, forceful grip, vibratory tools, sustained awkward posture
Systemic: obesity; preg (fluid retention + ↑weight -> ↑tunnel P -> transient CTS); DM (-> ↑n. susceptibility); hypothyroidism; RA; amyloidosis
↑risk trauma → imm C-spine stable: ↑speed MVC, axial loading (head-first impact), fall from height
any trauma w neuro Sx; esp midline neck pain, neuro Sx/S, distracting injury
AMS → immobilize + apply Canadian C-Spine/NEXUS b4 clear
Urgent: progress numb/tingle, radiate UE pain (cervical radiculopathy), weak, gait disturb, clumsy hand
bowel/bladder dysfun (→ cervical myelopathy/cord compress)    -  (+) red flag (fever, CA Hx) → urgent image
often wakes w or after awkward position/minor strain
Time: acute: hrs–days, strain/injury → local pain + spasm              -    radicular Sx → n.root
Episodic: recur w activity → mech/discogenic            -    gait disturb → stenosis/cord
Chronic: +12 wks → degen, structural deformity, or red flags = serious
postural abnorm: scoliosis, kyphosis, height loss → structural
Primary paraspinal musc: local paraspinal tender, spasm/tight, weak/fatigue
overuse/strain; ⍉dermatome, ⍉neuro deficit; reprod by loading affected musc, ease w rest
Bony spinal pain: well-local to vertebral level, worse @night, provoked by axial loading
post-trauma in at-risk pt → vertebral compress frx
long sit + repeat lift + chronic flex → DDD (axial pain worse sit/fwd bend)
repeat ext + rotation → facet arthropathy                                                    **worse w: ext/twist, AM, inactivity
Progress structural chg: curvature/asymmetry (scoliosis progress), height loss, ↑thoracic kyphosis (“dowager’s hump”)
acute focal pain post-minor trauma in osteoporotic pt (compress frx)
SI joint: butt + P. pelvic pain (medial to PSIS), worse w transition mvt (rise, roll over, stairs) + asymmetric load -1 leg stand
punch hard surface w closed fist → frx neck of
hallmark = axial impact on clenched fist
shoulder pain w overhead activity + night pain + ⍉lie on affected side
difficulty combing hair/reaching back pocket; weak w elev
wrist ext/grip (pain) → lat epicondyle pain (common extensor OG), worse w resist wrist ext
wrist flex/pronation (pain) → med epicondyle pain (common flexor OG)
radial-wrist pain w thumb abd + ulnar deviat
-    ACL rupture: sudden decel/"pop"/knee gives way
patellar tendinopathy, IT band syndrome, stress frx:
joint ROM angle   -  Tape measure: limb length & circumference -B/L  ≤~1 cm diff    -   marker: landmark/measure
NV screening tools: Reflex hammer: DTRs    -    Sensory screen: dull/sharp/soft/vibration/proprioception
Assess: symmetry, alignment: varus/valgus knee, angle/rotation
Soft-tissue: swelling, effusion, erythema, ecchymosis, atrophy, masses
UE: AC joint, greater tuberosity, bicipital groove, epicondyles, radial head, snuffbox, finger joints
LE: greater trochanter, knee joint lines, patella, tibial tuberosity, malleoli, Achilles, base of 5th MT
Spine: spinous process (midline tender/step-off), paraspinals, SI joints, C7 vertebra prominens, iliac crest @L4
AROM = limited, PROM = full → musc/tendinous      -    both limited → w.in joint
Active: willingness + functional motion) → passive (true ROM + end-feel)
Cervical:    -     flex ~45°            -    ext ~55°                  -    lat bend ~40°        -    rotation ~70°
Wrist:         -    flex ~90°            -    ext ~70°                   -    radial dev ~55°     -    ulnar dev ~50°
Abnormal: restricted (mech block or pain), excessive/unstable (laxity), pain through arc
0 = ⍉contract   -   1 = slight   -  2 = mvt w gravity elim   -  3 = gravity ⍉resist   -   4 = gravity + some resist   -  5 =  full resist
elbow flex C5–C6       -    wrist ext C6                     -    finger abd T1          -    hip flex L2–L3
knee ext L3–L4           -     ankle dorsiflex L4–L5    -    great-toe ext L5     -     ankle plantarflex S1
Vasc: distal pulses, cap refill, color, temp +
6 P’s (pain, pallor, pulseless, paresthesia, paralysis, poikilothermia)
Neuro: soft/sharp sensation -relevant dermatomes    -    motor strength distal to injury   -   DTRs
Sequence: Inspect → Palp → ROM (active then passive) → Strength (0–5) → Special tests
Above & below: joints above/below injury: referred, injuries transmitted
classic = squared-off shoulder of A. glenohumeral dislocation
Bony enlrg/prominant, asymmetric limb position, skin-fold asymmetry, limb shorten, abnorm rotation
frank dislocate, abnorm angle (⍉at joint), skin tenting (bone fragment vs skin → impending open frx)
Palpation: point bony tender → frx   -  warm → infect
Frx/dislocate -> poss injure adj n./vessels → doc
(deficit → limb-threaten vasc injury or n. entrapment -emergent intervention)                                                     **pulses, cap refill, color, temp, sensation, motor
Open frx: wound/bleed over frx, exposed bone, fat droplets
Compartment syndrome: pain out of prop + pain on passive stretch + tensely swollen firm + paresthesias
→ surgical emergency (P w/in ~20–30 mmHg of diastolic → emergent fasciotomy)
-   1st dorsal compartment @radial styloid → De Quervain's -restrict thumb/wrist ROM
lat epicondyle/common extensor OG → lat epicondylitis
med epicondyle/common flexor OG → med epicondylitis
graded weak local to 1 tendon + palp defect -> ↓integrity
Piano Key: (+) distal clavicle springs back up after depressed → AC instability
Neer (passive fwd flexion of IR arm): (+) reprod subacromial pain → impingement
Hawkins (fwd-flexed arm IR): (+) reprod subacromial pain → impingement
Empty-can (Jobe): (+) weak/pain w resisted elev in scapular plane, thumb down → supraspinatus
Drop-arm: (+) ⍉smoothly lower abd arm → cuff tear
Yergason (resist supination, elbow flex): (+) pain in bicipital groove → biceps tendon
Speed’s (resist fwd flexion, elbow ext + forearm supinated): (+) pain in bicipital groove → biceps tendon
O’Brien’s: (+) pain w resisted flexion worse in IR (thumb down), relieved in ER → labral (SLAP) or AC
Finkelstein: (+) ulnar deviation of wrist w thumb tucked reproduces radial-styloid pain → De Quervain’s
Cozen & Mill: (+) reprod lat epicondyle pain → lat epicondylitis
Tinel (tap over carpal tunnel): (+) reprod median paresthesias → carpal tunnel
Apley Scratch: pt reaches 1 hand over shoulder + down back (abd + ER) & other up back from below (add + IR)
Height each side → screens combined shoulder-motion restriction
-      palpable gap + heel swell + lost resting plantarflex → Achilles rupture
lat ankle swell/ecchymosis → inversion sprain              -    tibial tuberosity prominence → Osgood-Schlatter
pain, click along joint line/↓force w rotate flexed knee  ->
ballottement & bulge sign → effusion                            -    Thompson (squeeze calf, ⍉plantarflex) → Achilles rupture
Tinel (tap volar wrist) → median paresthesias = carpal tunnel
Spurling (ext + lat flex toward Sx side + axial compress) → radicular arm pain/
shoulder abd (hand on head) relief → cervical radiculopathy
SLR: supine, leg raised; (+) radic pain below knee @ ~30–70° → lumbar radi
stretches L5/S1 roots over herniated disc
unaffected leg reprod pain in affected leg = highly specific for disc herniation
N. -tension reprod → radiculopathy; axial mech pain ⍉reprod by SLR (tied to local loading)
relief w lumbar flexion → compress radicular/stenotic
